ingredients: chicken rice onion garlic ginger turmeric bay leaves yogurt ghee
instructions: 1. Soak basmati rice in water for 30 minutes. 2. Marinate chicken with yogurt, garlic, ginger, turmeric for 30 minutes. 3. Boil rice with bay leaves until 70% cooked. 4. Layer rice and marinated chicken in a heavy pot. 5. Add ghee and cover with foil. 6. Cook on high heat for 3-4 minutes until steam forms. 7. Reduce heat to low and cook for 30-35 minutes. 8. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

ingredients: chicken butter cream tomato onion garlic ginger chili
instructions: 1. Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 1 hour. 2. Cook chicken in a tandoor or oven at 200°C for 15 minutes. 3. In a pan, melt butter and sauté onions until golden. 4. Add garlic and ginger paste. 5. Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates. 6. Add cream and cooked chicken. 7. Simmer for 10-15 minutes. 8. Garnish with cilantro and serve with naan.

ingredients: basmati rice onion garlic ginger turmeric bay leaves cinnamon
instructions: 1. Soak rice in water for 20 minutes. 2. Boil water with whole spices. 3. Add rice and cook until 70% done. 4. Layer rice in a heavy pot with fried onions. 5. Cover with foil and place on tawa. 6. Cook on high heat for 3 minutes until steam forms. 7. Reduce heat and cook for 25-30 minutes. 8. Serve hot with raita.

ingredients: rice noodles shrimp tamarind sauce lime fish sauce garlic peanuts
instructions: 1. Soak rice noodles in warm water for 5 minutes. 2. Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry garlic and shrimp. 3. Add noodles and tamarind sauce. 4. Toss well and add lime juice. 5. Stir in peanuts and green onions. 6. Serve with lime wedges and crushed peanuts.

ingredients: coconut milk green curry paste chicken basil lime fish sauce
instructions: 1. Heat coconut milk in a pan. 2. Add green curry paste and simmer for 2 minutes. 3. Add chicken pieces and cook until done. 4. Add lime juice and fish sauce. 5. Stir in Thai basil. 6. Simmer for 10 minutes. 7. Serve with jasmine rice.

ingredients: spaghetti bacon eggs parmesan black pepper
instructions: 1. Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente. 2. Fry bacon until crispy and chop into pieces. 3. Beat eggs with grated parmesan and black pepper. 4. Drain pasta and toss with bacon. 5. Remove from heat and add egg mixture. 6. Toss quickly until creamy. 7. Serve immediately with extra parmesan.

ingredients: pizza dough tomatoes mozzarella basil olive oil salt
instructions: 1. Roll out pizza dough on a floured surface. 2. Brush with olive oil and place on pizza stone. 3. Spread tomato sauce evenly. 4. Add sliced mozzarella. 5. Bake at 250°C for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden. 6. Top with fresh basil and drizzle with olive oil. 7. Serve hot.

ingredients: tortillas pork pineapple onion cilantro lime
instructions: 1. Marinate sliced pork with chiles, spices and pineapple juice. 2. Layer meat and pineapple on a vertical spit. 3. Roast for 30-40 minutes until cooked. 4. Slice meat and pineapple from spit. 5. Serve in warm tortillas with onion and cilantro. 6. Squeeze lime juice before eating.

ingredients: poblano peppers cheese eggs tomato sauce onion
instructions: 1. Roast poblano peppers over flame until charred. 2. Peel off skin and remove seeds carefully. 3. Stuff with Oaxaca or mozzarella cheese. 4. Whip egg whites until stiff peaks form. 5. Fold in egg yolks gently. 6. Heat oil and dip peppers in egg batter. 7. Fry until golden on both sides. 8. Serve with warm tomato sauce.

ingredients: chicken bell peppers onion tortillas lime cilantro
instructions: 1. Slice chicken and bell peppers into strips. 2. Heat oil in a cast iron skillet. 3. Sauté onions until translucent. 4. Add peppers and chicken. 5. Season with cumin and chili powder. 6. Cook for 15 minutes until chicken is done. 7. Serve sizzling with warm tortillas and lime.

ingredients: eggs butter cheese milk salt pepper
instructions: 1. Beat eggs with milk, salt and pepper. 2. Heat butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat. 3. Pour egg mixture into pan. 4. Let it set for a few seconds. 5. Push cooked edges to center, tilting pan. 6. When mostly set but top is still wet, add cheese. 7. Fold in half and slide onto plate. 8. Serve immediately.

ingredients: flour eggs milk baking powder sugar butter
instructions: 1. Mix flour, baking powder and sugar in a bowl. 2. In another bowl, beat eggs with milk. 3. Combine wet and dry ingredients gently. 4. Heat butter on a griddle over medium heat. 5. Pour batter in circles. 6. Cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on top. 7. Flip and cook another 2 minutes until golden. 8. Serve with maple syrup and butter.

ingredients: bread eggs milk cinnamon sugar butter
instructions: 1. Beat eggs with milk, cinnamon and vanilla. 2. Heat butter on a skillet. 3. Dip bread slices in egg mixture, coating both sides. 4. Fry on hot skillet until golden brown. 5. Flip and cook other side until golden. 6. Dust with powdered sugar. 7. Serve with maple syrup and fresh berries.

ingredients: eggs tomato sauce onion bell pepper spices
instructions: 1. Heat oil and sauté onions and bell peppers. 2. Add tomato sauce and spices. 3. Simmer for 10 minutes until sauce thickens. 4. Make wells in sauce. 5. Crack eggs into each well. 6. Cover and cook 5-8 minutes until eggs are set to your liking. 7. Garnish with parsley. 8. Serve with pita bread.

ingredients: chicken peanuts soy sauce vinegar sesame oil ginger garlic
instructions: 1. Cut chicken into cubes and set aside. 2. Heat oil in a wok over high heat. 3. Stir-fry chicken until cooked through. 4. Add ginger and garlic. 5. Toss in dried chiles and peanuts. 6. Add soy sauce and vinegar. 7. Stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes. 8. Drizzle with sesame oil and serve over rice.

ingredients: tofu ground pork soy sauce ginger garlic chili oil
instructions: 1. Heat oil and stir-fry ground pork. 2. Add garlic and ginger. 3. Cut soft tofu into cubes. 4. Add tofu to pork carefully. 5. Pour in soy sauce and broth. 6. Add Sichuan peppercorns and chili oil. 7. Simmer for 10 minutes. 8. Thicken with cornstarch slurry if desired. 9. Serve over steamed rice.

ingredients: cooked rice soy sauce eggs vegetables sesame oil
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a wok or large pan. 2. Scramble eggs and remove from pan. 3. Add cold cooked rice and break up clumps. 4. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes. 5. Add vegetables and stir-fry. 6. Pour soy sauce and mix well. 7. Add eggs back in. 8. Drizzle with sesame oil and serve.

ingredients: tomatoes cucumber olives feta cheese onion olive oil
instructions: 1. Chop tomatoes and cucumbers. 2. Slice red onion thinly. 3. Combine tomatoes, cucumbers, onions and olives in a bowl. 4. Cube feta cheese. 5. Add feta to the bowl. 6. Drizzle with olive oil and vinegar. 7. Season with salt and pepper. 8. Toss gently and serve immediately.

ingredients: chickpeas tahini lemon garlic olive oil
instructions: 1. Drain canned chickpeas, reserving some liquid. 2. Add chickpeas to food processor. 3. Add tahini, garlic, and lemon juice. 4. Blend until smooth, adding reserved liquid as needed. 5. Season with salt to taste. 6. Transfer to a serving bowl. 7. Drizzle with olive oil. 8. Garnish with paprika and serve with pita.

ingredients: pasta seasonal vegetables garlic olive oil parmesan basil
instructions: 1. Boil pasta according to package directions. 2. Heat olive oil in a large pan. 3. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds. 4. Add seasonal vegetables like zucchini, carrots, bell peppers. 5. Sauté until tender-crisp, about 8 minutes. 6. Toss with drained pasta. 7. Add fresh basil and parmesan. 8. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

ingredients: chicken yogurt tomato cream ginger garlic spices
instructions: 1. Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 2 hours. 2. Grill or bake chicken at 200°C for 20 minutes. 3. In a pan, sauté onions until golden. 4. Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates. 5. Add cream and cooked chicken. 6. Simmer for 15 minutes. 7. Garnish with cilantro. 8. Serve with naan or rice.

ingredients: egg noodles cabbage carrots soy sauce sesame oil garlic
instructions: 1. Boil noodles and drain. 2. Heat oil in a wok. 3. Stir-fry garlic for 30 seconds. 4. Add cabbage and carrots. 5. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes. 6. Add noodles and soy sauce. 7. Toss well for 2-3 minutes. 8. Drizzle with sesmo oil and serve hot.

ingredients: eggplant zucchini bell pepper tomato onion garlic herbs
instructions: 1. Chop eggplant, zucchini, bell pepper, tomato and onion. 2. Heat olive oil in a large pot. 3. Sauté onion and garlic. 4. Add other vegetables. 5. Add tomato sauce and herbs. 6. Simmer for 35-40 minutes until vegetables are tender. 7. Season with salt and pepper. 8. Serve warm or at room temperature.

ingredients: black lentils red kidney beans butter cream tomato ginger garlic
instructions: 1. Soak lentils and kidney beans overnight. 2. Pressure cook until tender. 3. In a pan, melt butter and add tomato puree. 4. Add ginger and garlic. 5. Add cooked lentils and beans. 6. Add cream and simmer for 15-20 minutes. 7. Season with salt and garam masala. 8. Garnish with cilantro and serve with naan.

ingredients: chicken yogurt tandoori spice lemon
instructions: 1. Mix yogurt with tandoori spice powder. 2. Marinate chicken pieces for 2 hours. 3. Preheat oven to 200°C. 4. Place chicken on a baking tray. 5. Bake for 25-30 minutes until cooked through. 6. The chicken should be charred at edges. 7. Squeeze lemon juice before serving. 8. Serve with mint chutney and lemon.

ingredients: rice paper shrimp vegetables cilantro mint
instructions: 1. Soak rice paper in warm water. 2. Prepare cooked shrimp and shredded vegetables. 3. Place a rice paper on a damp cloth. 4. Add shrimp, vegetables, cilantro and mint. 5. Fold sides and roll tightly. 6. Place seam side down on a plate. 7. Serve with peanut dipping sauce. 8. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

ingredients: potato peas onion pastry cumin turmeric
instructions: 1. Boil and mash potatoes. 2. Mix with peas, onion and spices. 3. Make pastry dough with flour and ghee. 4. Cut into triangles and fill with potato mixture. 5. Fold edges to seal. 6. Heat oil for deep frying. 7. Fry samosas until golden brown. 8. Serve with tamarind chutney.

ingredients: rice arborio wine vegetable broth butter parmesan onion
instructions: 1. Heat vegetable broth in a separate pot. 2. Sauté diced onion in butter until soft. 3. Add arborio rice and toast for 2 minutes. 4. Add white wine and stir until absorbed. 5. Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly. 6. Continue adding broth until rice is creamy and al dente. 7. Stir in butter and parmesan. 8. Season with salt and pepper. 9. Serve immediately.
